```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
```

```{r}
# Raw data stored locally in Documents\Advanced_Methods_Roll\Project 3\Code
heart <- read_csv("../DataRaw/frmgham2.csv")
```

# Data Cleaning
```{r}
# n = 4434
heart <- heart %>% 
  filter(PERIOD == 1) %>% #baseline covariates
  filter(STROKE != 1) %>% #exclude prior stroke # n = 4019
  mutate(time_stroke_yrs = TIMESTRK/365.25) %>% # Convert time stroke to years
  mutate(
    time_stroke_yrs = pmin(time_stroke_yrs, 10),
    censored = ifelse(time_stroke_yrs < 10, 1, 0),
    SEX = case_when(SEX == 1 ~ "Male",
                     SEX == 2 ~ "Female")
  )

heart_male <- heart %>% filter(SEX == "Male") # n = 1751
heart_female <- heart %>% filter(SEX == "Female") # n = 2268
```

# Table 1
```{r}

```

# Overall

```{r}
surv<-survfit(Surv(time_stroke_yrs, censored)~SEX, data=heart)

ggsurvplot(surv, xlim=c(0, 10))
```

# Male

```{r}
coxph(Surv(time_stroke_yrs, censored)~AGE + DIABETES + SYSBP, 
      data = heart_male)
```
# Female

```{r}
coxph(Surv(time_stroke_yrs, censored)~AGE + DIABETES + SYSBP, 
      data = heart_female)
```
